people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.
translations.bsb: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out against us in battle, but we defeated them.
